app.title: Kugelblitz – Mac-Native Google Earth Alternative
app.author: luoc
app.description: A native macOS desktop application that provides 3‑D map navigation similar to Google Earth, with offline caching and OpenStreetMap data.
proposed_tests: Download the installer and verify integrity via checksum.
Launch the app and confirm the main window loads within 10 seconds.
Export a map tile using the CLI and verify the file format and size.
Measure CPU and memory usage during a 5‑minute navigation session.
